### 1. Technical Environment

* **code_version:** c00899e0b7252b6a54aad558499917f0548c3524
* **component:** plugins/dso/scripts/pr-comment-response.sh lines 354-378

### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** User-Flagged Behavior

#### Expected Behavior

The create-bug skill documents a Consolidation Rule for Priority 4 findings: "When multiple Priority 4 (nitpick) findings share the same Component, consolidate into a single cleanup ticket." A parallel rule should apply to deferred PR comments — either a single rolling "PR <N> — sweep deferred comments" task per PR, or at minimum a dedup check against existing open deferred-comment tickets on the same PR.

#### Actual Behavior

\`pr-comment-response.sh\` unconditionally creates a new P3 task per deferred comment, with no PR-scoped dedup and no consolidation. A PR with 30 review comments where each gets deferred can produce 30 separate P3 tickets, each with low-information titles (see related P3 bug for title quality). This pollutes the open-ticket list and propagates through the Jira bridge as 30 separate DIG issues.

Observed in production: 8 \`PR comment deferred:\` Jira issues (DIG-2419..DIG-2433) were deleted on 2026-05-14 as part of a Jira reconciliation pass. The set spans multiple PRs and several near-identical "Agreed, we should track this separately." titles.

### 5. Skills and Workflows

* plugins/dso/scripts/pr-comment-response.sh — script that creates the tickets
* plugins/dso/skills/create-bug/SKILL.md — Consolidation Rule for P4 nitpicks (precedent)

Suggested fix: introduce a per-PR consolidation task (looked up by tag \`pr-<N>-deferred\` or by querying open deferred tickets with PR-link metadata) and append each new deferred comment as a bullet under that ticket's description, rather than minting a new ticket per comment.
data.title: [pr-comment-response]: every deferred comment creates a fresh P3 task -> no dedup or consolidation, can spawn dozens per PR
